en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall, rectangular tower with an open balustraded viewing platform (belvedere) at the top, set among trees. A wooden bridge with brick posts leads toward the tower, and several children in early 20th‑century clothing stand on the bridge. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene, with additional handwritten notes over the margin.
